description: Customer-facing Mink on WhatsApp (docs/whatsapp-commerce-plan.md §13). Each case is one customer message against a fixture facts sheet (`fixture`), with the outcome the answer must have. Offline, the harness runs the deterministic gate and the answer parser only; with --live it sends each case to the model exactly as lib/whatsapp/mink-answer.ts would and grades the JSON that comes back. `mustMention` and `mustNotMention` are checked case-insensitively against the reply of an `answer`. A `gate` case must be refused by the gate (its reason) before any model call.
